jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K , one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock® , Borderlands® , Mafia , Sid Meier’s Civilization® , and XCOM® , as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K , TopSpin® , and PGA TOUR® 2K . We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

What We Need

We’re looking for a passionate Staff Data Analyst to support the Sports* Game Science & Insights team, to explore, analyze, report, and action on data from our portfolio of titles (WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K). We’re looking for someone who can translate product & business knowledge into deep analysis and, in turn, translate to actionable insights for cross functional business stakeholders. As you deliver valuable insights to stakeholders, you will aim to build strong relationships, become a trusted partner among business functions, and scale out team efforts from one team to the next. Our mission is to enable our partners to be more proactive, productive & successful by providing best in class, end-to-end and scalable data solutions.

What You Will Do

Leverage a deep understanding of how our titles’ game features & mechanics work and our business priorities to deliver actionable, business-impacting insights
Support business narratives and develop business cases with effective data storytelling. Focus on using data and hypothesis-driven decision-making to drive future growth and customer lifetime value
Learn different business teams’ and stakeholders’ ways of working and preferences for understanding data, and be a bridge between the data team and business teams (Product, Marketing, Commercial) to translate complex business needs into data-related projects
Tailor the output to match stakeholder needs, including reports, visualizations, charts, and tables
Gain an understanding of internal titles outside of our portfolio (NBA 2K, Borderlands, other 2K titles) to provide strong benchmarking and comparison points for business performance
Lead the exploration of creative new ways of measurement to identify patterns and causal relationships
Empower teams to track and analyze activity/productivity and support their research projects, leading the efforts towards building scalable self-service tools
Act as a subject matter expert to support analysts and other data-users to improve their capabilities. Grow and develop best practices that contribute to both the team and wider business understanding of our players
Data doesn't just appear overnight, we work with our stakeholders to understand what data matters most to their business and strategy. In addition to delivering insights on what is available to us, this role will be responsible for liaising with stakeholders to proactively identify what data we need to begin to record for future initiatives that drive value

What Will Make You A Great Fit

The ideal candidate for this role has the ability to see the underlying story in the data, know how to ask the right questions and relate output back to measurable player or business outcomes. A solution-oriented and creative problem solver. A self-starter with the passion and enthusiasm to join a growing insights team to get results for meaningful change.

Track record of successfully leading the delivery of insights and analysis across business functions (Product, Commercial, Marketing)
Proven ability to produce impactful insights that resulted in tangible enhancements to product or business outcomes
Profound knowledge in SQL
Great communication skills and a clear understanding of how to make insights understandable and actionable for the business
High degree of proactivity and curiosity to understand, measure, and improve our understanding of our players and their behaviour
Ability to lead the delivery of complex projects, manage changing priorities and coach others to success
Understanding internal customer satisfaction as one of your key success factors
Profound experience in data modeling (strong nice to have: data science language, such as Python or R)
Experience in data visualization tools, such as Tableau
Video games experience & passion - particularly in sports titles

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

The City of West Hollywood is like no other city in the world. Be an expert with Esri products, including administration and deployment of ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise (ArcGIS Server & Portal for ArcGIS), ArcGIS Online, and Field Maps.
Possess hands-on expertise in designing and implementing advanced ArcGIS enterprise system solutions to address complex municipal challenges.
Have strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, and SQL, with experience in scripting to automate ETL workflows, GIS tasks, and integrating GIS with other enterprise applications.
Have experience with administering and maintaining SQL Server enterprise geodatabases, including schema design, user permissions, indexing, performance tuning, data integrity controls, stored procedures, views, and support for published enterprise GIS services.
Demonstrate proficiency in web mapping technologies, such as ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript and Leaflet, with a strong understanding of UI/UX principles for designing intuitive, accessible, and user-centered GIS applications.
Excel in project management processes, guiding projects from inception to completion while managing multiple priorities in a professional environment with engaged stakeholders.
Conduct research and analysis to solve complex technical and administrative problems, making professional recommendations and proposing alternatives.
Demonstrate the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail.
Possess excellent communication skills, with the ability to interpret and convey complex technical information to the public, executives, and both technical and non-technical staff.
Collaborate effectively with various departments to understand their geospatial needs and create tailored solutions.
Be an independent self-starter with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
Experience with Tyler Energov/EP&L is a plus, but not required.

Key Responsibilities

Architect and maintain the city's geospatial infrastructure, ensuring scalability and performance.
Publish, document, and maintain authoritative GIS datasets and services across enterprise and web-based platforms, ensuring that data is accurate, discoverable, appropriately secured, and supported by clear metadata, data dictionaries, service descriptions, and update schedules.
Develop custom GIS applications and tools to streamline city operations and improve service delivery.
Conduct spatial analysis to support data-driven decision-making across city departments.
Create high-quality maps and visualizations for both internal and public-facing applications.
Stay current on Esri platform capabilities and broader geospatial technology trends, developing and maintaining a GIS technology roadmap that guides system architecture, application development, data management, integrations, modernization efforts, and long-term platform investment.
Act as the City’s primary internal administrator for the Tyler Enterprise Permitting and Licensing platform.

This position is eligible to work remotely for up to 50% of its time,
subject to approval and based on the ongoing operational needs of the City.

For a complete list of duties, please refer to the class specification at: Systems Engineer

IT Manager

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university in a related field; and,
Three (3) to four (4) years of progressively responsible experience; or,
Any combination of education, training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

The Virginia SBDC is a program of Mason Enterprise.

Capital Pathways is a specialized program within the Virginia SBDC network that empowers Virginia small businesses to secure the capital they need to grow. It is designed for very small (fewer than 10 employees) and emerging and growth-ready businesses that face challenges accessing traditional financing. The program offers an immersive, hands-on experience focused on financial and legal readiness. Act as a subject matter expert to support analysts and other data-users to improve their capabilities. Grow and develop best practices that contribute to both the team and wider business understanding of our players

new_jobs.description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 10 rankings in ENR. With over 60 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

Cumming Group is looking for a Senior Project Coordinator who plays a critical role in supporting both operational staffing functions and project delivery teams. This position is responsible for coordinating resource planning, staffing assignments, and utilization tracking within Deltek, while also providing high-level administrative and project support to the Principal-in-Charge and associated project teams. The role is split approximately between Resource Planning Support and Project Administration Support, requiring strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Resource Planning Support

Utilize Deltek Vantagepoint to manage staffing assignments and labor utilization across all projects.
Collaborate with leadership to assign staff based on labor categories, experience, skill, availability, project requirements, and utilization goals.
Monitor staffing trends, identify potential staffing issues, and work with leadership to offer solutions to maximize staff utilization while also preventing burnout.
Update project staffing plans and resource assignments in Deltek Vantagepoint, ensuring data is accurate, complete, and entered in a timely manner.
Participate in monthly staffing review meetings to assess project staffing needs, balance workloads, and optimize staff utilization.
Maintain a comprehensive overview of staff utilization, project assignments, and anticipated resource needs, including in pursuit / pipeline projects.
Develop, customize, and manage reports to provide leadership and project teams with insights into current and future staffing needs.
Prepare and distribute monthly project, employee and utilization reports for senior leadership.
Serve as an internal resource for Deltek Vantagepoint project planning, resource management, staffing processes, and related reporting functions.
Work with the Billing Department to ensure projects are accurately set up in Deltek and are updated as project milestones, contract modifications, and extensions occur.

Principal-in-Charge & Project Team Administrative Support

Schedule and facilitate meetings with stakeholders throughout various stages of the project.
Coordinate project meetings, agendas, action items, and follow-up activities.
Calendar management for both the principal in charge and project management teams.
Liaison between the project management team and users/clients.
Efficiently manage a multi-line telephone system to promptly address, screen, or redirect calls, assisting with information provision or appointment scheduling.

Assist in document preparation tasks, including printing or emailing documents to internal and external contacts.
Provide general administrative support to ensure efficient project operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, resource management, or a related field.
Knowledge of Deltek Vantagepoint preferred but not required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
Analytical skills with the ability to evaluate staffing data, utilization metrics, and resource planning reports.
Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional and client-focused approach.
Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams.

About The Department

The Virginia Small Business Development Center (SBDC) Network is a partnership with the US SBA and other local hosts to provide counseling services and training to Small Businesses in Virginia. The Virginia SBDC leads office administers and manages the SBDC network of 25 centers across Virginia with 13 subrecipients including universities, community colleges, and economic development organizations. The Virginia SBDC is a program of Mason Enterprise.

Capital Pathways is a specialized program within the Virginia SBDC network that empowers Virginia small businesses to secure the capital they need to grow. It is designed for very small (fewer than 10 employees) and emerging and growth-ready businesses that face challenges accessing traditional financing. The program offers an immersive, hands-on experience focused on financial and legal readiness. Through group-based workshops and bootcamps, discussion-style webinars with guest speakers, bookkeeping trainings, and peer support groups — paired with extended one-on-one assistance from financial, accounting, and legal experts — business owners don’t just learn what to do — they actively build the systems and habits needed to access capital and grow with confidence.

About The Position

The Program Coordinator supports the effective implementation of the SBDC Capital Pathways Program. The Coordinator manages client intake and referral processes, maintains high-quality data and reporting systems, and supports outreach, training, and grants administration. This role requires strong communication and organizational skills, shown interest in small business and local economic development, and the ability to support program delivery in alignment with federal grant requirements and timelines.

The Program Coordinator will work primarily in the SBDC's Fairfax Virginia offices, with the possibility of a hybrid work arrangement.

Responsibilities

Client Intake, Outreach, & Event Support:

Conducts initial intake calls with prospective clients to assess business needs and determine program fit;
Refers clients to the appropriate technical assistance advisors or partners based on their needs and eligibility;
Follows-up with clients after missed meetings, cancellations, or expressions of interest; and
Hosts Zoom webinars and assists in filtering and organizing participant questions, and coordinating logistics for in-person trainings.

Client Relationship Management (CRM) Software Data Management

Performs routine audits of client data in the CRM system to ensure completeness and accuracy;
Ensures meeting notes and client interaction records are documented appropriately for reporting and analysis;
Enters events into the CRM system, tracks attendance, and reconciles events; and
Tracks and reports on impact by Capital Pathways' clients.

Program Communications & Reporting Support

Assists in the preparation of program newsletters, webinar promotions, client success stories, and annual reports; and
Helps collect relevant data and materials from partners and internal systems.

Administrative & Grant Support

Populates monthly budget monitoring tools and supports tracking spending against program budget;
Supports grant compliance by tracking sponsor reporting deadlines; and
Processes vendor invoices and assists with procurement documentation as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience;
Experience using Microsoft Office applications in a professional setting;
Experience professionally engaging with diverse stakeholders, clients, or program participants;
Experience learning and handling administrative and programmatic tasks independently;
Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to produce professional emails, reports, and meeting notes;
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal supervision;
Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to engage confidently with small business clients and external stakeholders;
Self-starter with initiative and curiosity, and eager to learn new concepts relevant to the program;
Comfortable contributing ideas and participating actively in collaborative team discussions;
Strong attention to detail, especially in data entry, recordkeeping, and financial tracking; and
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Outlook, Word, and Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting small business, entrepreneurship, or economic development programs;
Exposure to or work with underserved business communities;
Experience working with financial institutions, community lenders, or access-to-capital initiatives;
Experience supporting program compliance or reporting requirements for federally funded or grant-supported programs;
Experience drafting or helping develop communication materials such as success stories, program reports, or newsletters;
Experience planning or providing logistical support for webinars, trainings, or community-facing events;
Knowledge of small business development, entrepreneurship support services, or local economic ecosystems;
Bilingual or multilingual communication skills preferred;
Ability to support the preparation of public-facing materials like newsletters, client success stories, or program updates; and
Familiarity with federal or state program requirements, particularly related to grants or contracts.
